Hi Lara,

Thanks again for the time on the intro call earlier. We'd love to lock in the formal product demo and make sure your execs have a short pre-brief so the session lands with the right audience. Two asks from our side:

- Can you confirm whether your CIO/CTO will attend the demo? We typically schedule a 20–25 minute executive walkthrough followed by a technical deep-dive.
- Would you be open to a 20–30 minute sponsor dry‑run the day of the demo (to align talking points and any custom slides)?

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Tue Oct 12 — 11:00–12:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Oct 13 — 10:00–11:00 or 16:00–17:00

I've attached a one‑pager and draft deck for context (AtlasBio_Deck_v1.pdf). If any of those windows work, I'll send an invite and loop in our Solutions Architect to run the technical segment.

Thanks — Diego

A couple requests from my side so we can come prepared:
- Keep the exec walkthrough to ~25 minutes (top business outcomes, deployment model, security posture).
- Please include a short technical appendix (3–4 slides) showing data residency options and how you handle KV cache / latency for long contexts — our platform team will want that.
- We'll have one procurement attendee (procurement@atlasbio.com) on the call to listen for SOW/contractable items.

Also, confirm whether the sponsor dry-run 09:00–09:30 PT is only internal to AtlasBio + Redwood, or if you expect other stakeholders. If internal-only, 09:00 works. If you need our product folks on that call, we may need 09:30.

Thanks — Michael
